snippet.title: Tomb Raider: Lost and Found - Chapter One | Definitive Edition Trailer
snippet.description:
"Every myth or legend has a beginning and an end, but in real life things are simply not that easy."

Tomb Raider: Lost and Found - Chapter One sprint jumps to TRLE.net with a new update that includes improved gameplay and level design. 

In addition, the update features "The Art of Tomb Raider: Lost and Found", a visual companion to the game. Take a glimpse into the visual development of the artwork behind Lara Croft’s first adventure. Through many stunning illustrations, learn what motivates the protagonist to travel to the dangerous sands of Saudi Arabia.

Tomb Raider: Lost and Found - Chapter One is available to download here:
https://trcustoms.org/levels/3711
https://www.trle.net/sc/levelfeatures.php?lid=3692
